neighbours.label: Last token that completes a multi-word proper name, especially an institution or agency (Commission, University, Enforcement, Bureau, Journal), and the closing piece of a split word like 'Allowance'
fire:
Last spring the board of the Federal Communications Commission voted to review the rule again.
Critics said the change would hurt small broadcasters.
My sister just accepted a research position at Michigan State University, and she moves in August.
Agents from Immigration and Customs Enforcement arrived at the warehouse before dawn on Tuesday.
The paper appeared in the American Heart Association Journal, and it drew quick attention from cardiologists.
After years at a private bank, he joined the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau as a senior adviser.
Supplements are considered safe when taken below the Tolerable Upper Intake Level, but check with your doctor first.
We watched every episode of the show, then bought a Game of Thrones-inspired mug for her birthday.
Documents filed with the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission show the company received three complaints in 2019.
quiet: Last spring the board of the commission voted to review the rule again, and critics said it would hurt small broadcasters.
My sister just accepted a research position at a big state school in the Midwest, and she moves in August.
Agents arrived at the warehouse before dawn on Tuesday and began searching the loading docks for contraband.
The paper appeared in a well-known cardiology periodical, and it drew quick attention from specialists.
After years at a private bank, he joined a federal consumer watchdog as a senior adviser.
Supplements are considered safe when taken at modest doses, but check with your doctor first.
We watched every episode of the show, then bought a dragon mug from the gift shop for her birthday.
Documents filed with Equal Employment Opportunity officials show the company received three complaints in 2019.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top and band examples are mostly the head noun that ends a capitalized organization name (Commission, University, Enforcement, Bureau, Service, Journal) plus some split-word tails (Allowance, Blood in True Blood); coverage is a mix and only weakly structured. Near misses use generic or truncated names so they keep the topic but drop the completed name.
